title: Classic Hollywood Black & White Portrait
prompt_text: Create a vintage Hollywood black-and-white cinematic portrait of [the person in the photo]. Style: 1940s-1950s glamour photography, three-point studio lighting with strong key light from upper-left and rim backlight, deep blacks and lustrous highlights, fine-grained silver halide film texture. Subject: tight head-and-shoulders close-up, classic film-star pose, hair styled with period waves or pompadour, neutral background fading to dark. Preserve facial features and identity exactly. Output: 1024×1536 portrait, magazine-print archival quality.

title: Old Hollywood Studio Portrait Color
prompt_text: Create a vintage Old Hollywood color cinematic portrait of [the person in the photo]. Style: 1950s Technicolor era studio glamour, soft warm key light, gentle rim light from behind, slightly desaturated period color palette, subtle film grain. Subject: medium portrait, three-quarter angle, classic glamour styling, satin or velvet wardrobe, simple painted-canvas studio backdrop. Preserve subject's facial features and identity exactly. Output: 1024×1536, vintage cover-shoot magazine quality.

title: Vermeer Window Light Portrait
prompt_text: Create a quiet, contemplative cinematic portrait of [the person in the photo] inspired by Vermeer's interior paintings. Subject: side-profile or three-quarter pose, gazing softly toward soft window light from camera-left. Setting: minimalist interior room with neutral plaster wall, single tall window, sheer curtain diffusing daylight. Lighting: gentle directional natural daylight only, falloff into shadow on the dark side. Color: muted earthy palette, soft cream highlights and umber shadows. Preserve facial features exactly. Output: 1024×1536 portrait, painterly photographic quality.
